sources.title: Llama-2-7b-hf: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Llama-2-7b-hf is a 7 billion parameter pretrained language model from meta-llama converted to Hugging Face Transformers format. Built as an auto-regressive transformer, the model was trained on 2 trillion tokens of publicly available data with a 4,096 token context window, completing pretraining between January and July 2023. sources.title: GitHub - meta-llama/llama: Inference code for Llama models
sources.snippet: This release includes model weights and starting code for pre-trained and fine-tuned Llama language models — ranging from 7B to 70B parameters. This repository is intended as a minimal example to load Llama 2 models and run inference. For more detailed examples leveraging Hugging Face, see llama-cookbook.
